reviews.text: I’ve loved this app, but …. This has been my go-to app for more than a year. In the last week an update that it removed one of the things that I had loved. Now, it only shows the day’s steps and overall trends, whereas before there were three screens that also showed the past week’s performance and accumulation. I really loved that function and now it seems to have disappeared. I paid for the Plus version of this app and am not sure what has happened.
Simple. Simple and sweet. Nothing more nothing else.

In the right direction. Coming from a pixel watch and hated the Apple stock activity tracker, I really like to have a pedometer readout at a glance and with apples built-in complications, it’s not really possible. That’s very cheap complication, does somewhat alleviate the problem however, I really wish that it came with two complication types. The circles with your daily step and weekly step is nice, but I’d much rather have a number read out, integrated into a complication. I’d like to see that added in the future if possible. Just a little, not ugly looking. Number readout for daily step count. The circles this complication currently offers. It’s nice though it looks good and at least now the rings actually are showing my step my steps but I’d still much rather see a number at a glance. Worth the .30 cents though, I’ll pay more if a new version releases with both complication options… sadly most of the other step complications on the use your phone as the to compute steps and that’s not helpful. This one seems to use watch sensors ! Also, all of the other available complications that just have a number read out are pretty ugly, so maybe this developer can make some thing that just looks a little more refined as far as a number readoyt goes their rings look nice.

Overcounts steps. I REALLY want to love this app. In theory, it does exactly what I need: It provides a steps complication for my Apple Watch. 

But the counting is inaccurate. For example, I went out for lunch today, and when I got home, I'd logged about 1,000 steps. Based upon where I had parked and eaten, that seemed correct. Came home, did some laundry, and changed my bed linens and now it shows 3,360 steps!! There's NO WAY that's accurate!!

Developer, if you can prove that this is the fault of the watch and NOT your app, I'll revise my review. I realize it's a free app and I'm grateful for that. But it needs to be accurate!! If accuracy costs money, I'll pay. But "free and inaccurate" isn't working for me.
Odd. Tracks arm movements too.
Have to close app and reopen to see total steps during the day!. Cannot say much more. Hard to get enough words to satisfy this review. Guess I should change it to 3 stars!

However, I was shocked to learn that you can only see the step count for the present day. I walked quite a bit yesterday, including late last night. However, that step count disappeared at midnight and was reset to zero for this morning. There does not appear to be a way of checking previous days!

reviews.text: Best app to count steps on the Apple Watch. Great app. The daily and weekly ring is a great motivator
Great App!. This is a phenomenal app clearly created by a genius.

Great, but one major drawback. Quite shocked the Apple Watch doesn’t have a pedometer app with complications built in from the get go, as I’m sure that many are like myself “upgrading” from a fitbit or similar.

But on to this app. First of all, virtually everything is a positive. Well designed and intuitive etc. 

However (I presume this is due to a limitation of the Apple Watch) it is *very* slow to update on the complication.

I had a fitbit previously that updated as you walked. With this app and the Apple Watch, I find myself opening the fitness app and scrolling down to find my actual steps, as the complication is often several hundred behind. There’s no alert when you’ve reached your daily target either.

Overall, worth keeping an eye on and the developer has a great eye for design and UI. Would love to see live step counting and a goal completed alert.
